title: Add key password for Android export and configured signature options
key_points: Adds support for adding a key password when exporting to Android in Godot
Provides configured signature options for Android exports
Improves security by requiring a key password during the export process
limitations: The source does not specify any limitations or caveats.
asserts: This pull request adds an additional layer of security to the Android exporting process in Godot by allowing users to set a key password and provides configured signature options.
scope: This change specifically relates to the Android export functionality within the Godot game engine.
